verse.verse_1: When the sun shall be wound round,
verse.verse_2: And when the stars shall dart down,
verse.verse_3: And when the mountains shall be made to pass away,
verse.verse_4: And when the she-camels big with young shall be abandoned,
verse.verse_5: And when the wild beasts shall be gathered together,
verse.verse_6: And when the seas shall be filled,
verse.verse_7: And when the souls he paired,
verse.verse_8: And when the girl buried alive shall be asked:
verse.verse_9: For what sin she was slain.
verse.verse_10: And when the Writs shall be lain open,
verse.verse_11: And when the heaven shall be stripped,
verse.verse_12: And when the Scorch shall be made to blaze,
verse.verse_13: And when the Garden shall be brought nigh,
verse.verse_14: Then every soul shall know that which it: hath presented.
verse.verse_15: I swear by the receding stars.
verse.verse_17: And by the night when it departeth,
verse.verse_18: And by the morning when it shineth forth,
verse.verse_19: Verily it is a Word brought by a messenger honoured,
verse.verse_20: Owner of strength, of established dignity with the Lord of the Throne.
verse.verse_23: Assuredly he beheld him in the horizon manifest.
verse.verse_24: And he is of the unseen not a tenacious concealer.
verse.verse_25: Nor is it the word of a Satan accursed.
verse.verse_27: This is naught but an Admonition Unto the worlds-
verse.verse_28: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
verse.verse_29: And ye shall not will unless it be that Allah, the Lord of the worlds, willeth.
